hypothesis: A backward anchored to native intermediates with fixed int8 codes and differentiable scales can match the local derivative inside unchanged quantization cells; this alone may not change output ranking.
cell_definition: Both perturbations preserve native codes, max-absolute index and sign at FFN-input, FFN-down-input and output-input quantizers. Report all cross-cell and ambiguous comparisons separately without deleting them.
local_gate: Each case needs at least two unchanged-cell comparisons; all qualifying finite differences must satisfy the preregistered derivative tolerance and sign agreement. Insufficient unchanged cells is inconclusive, not a pass.
acceptance_rule: Use the first preregistered step whose proposed negative-gradient direction actually lowers native NLL by more than 1e-6; otherwise report no accepted diagnostic step. No optimizer update.
failure_action: Do not change DG-001 or reclassify NLL improvement as memory capability. Passing local math does not approve a training method or architectural promotion.
